description: Source code for managing game statistics in the Battle for Wesnoth project, including classes and functions for recording, merging, and serializing game scenario and unit statistics.

classes.name: scenario_stats
classes.description: Holds statistics for a specific game scenario, including team stats and scenario name.

classes.name: stats
classes.description: Represents various game statistics such as recruits, kills, attacks, and damages.

classes.name: disabler
classes.description: Manages enabling/disabling statistics collection via RAII.

classes.name: scenario_context
classes.description: Context manager for scenario statistics, manages scenario lifecycle.

classes.name: attack_context
classes.description: Handles attack and defend events, updates stats accordingly.

methods.name: scenario_stats::scenario_stats
methods.description: Constructor initializing scenario stats from config.

methods.name: stats::stats
methods.description: Default constructor initializing stats to zero.

methods.name: disabler::disabler
methods.description: Increments stats_disabled to disable stats collection.

methods.name: disabler::~disabler
methods.description: Decrements stats_disabled to re-enable stats collection.

methods.name: scenario_context::scenario_context
methods.description: Initializes scenario context, adds new scenario if needed.

methods.name: attack_context::attack_context
methods.description: Constructor for attack context, stores attacker and defender info.

methods.name: attack_context::attack_result
methods.description: Records attack outcome, updates stats accordingly.

methods.name: attack_context::defend_result
methods.description: Records defend outcome, updates stats accordingly.

methods.name: calculate_stats
methods.description: Calculates and returns stats for a given category and side.

methods.name: clear_current_scenario
methods.description: Removes the last scenario from master stats.

methods.name: sum_str_int_map
methods.description: Sums all values in a string-int map.
